PID

PID Controllers are used in commercial HVAC,  P (proportional only) , PI and PID

P (only) 

For example, to heat a classroom, using wall radiators installed under windows, P (only) proportional is used. Normally the thermostat is near the door entrance. This works well because, the the rise and fall in temperature (error from setpoint)  is very ,very slow (integral) using natural convection from the radiator. 
 
PI

An integral (or time based approach) help prevent rapid overheating / underheating from the setpoint. The mass majority of commercial thermostats use PI. 

PID 

Normally not used in a classroom, but rather in highly critical locations, like a lab, hospital or food processing use the (D) derivative part keep the room as close to exactly to setpoint without overheating or underheating

PID Controllers are used in commercial HVAC,  P (proportional only) , PI and PID

P (only)

PI

An integral (or time based approach) help prevent rapid overheating / underheating from the setpoint. The mass majority of commercial thermostats use PI. 

PID 

Normally not used in a classroom, but rather in highly critical locations, like a lab, hospital or food processing use the (D) derivative part keep the room as close to exactly to setpoint without overheating or underheating

PID Controllers are used in commercial HVAC,  P (proportional only) , PI and PID

P (only) 

For example, to heat a classroom, using wall radiators installed under windows, P (only) proportional is used. Normally the thermostat is near the door entrance. This works well because, the the rise and fall in temperature (error from setpoint)  is very ,very slow (integral) using natural convection from the radiator. 
 
PI 

If the same classroom was using hot air for heating,  PI is used. The rise a fall in temperature (error from setpoint) can move faster, since you are forcing air around the room. An integral (or time based approach) help prevent rapid overheating / underheating from the setpoint. The mass majority of commercial thermostats use PI. 

PID 

Normally not used in a classroom, but rather in highly critical locations, like a lab, hospital or food processing use the (D) derivative part keep the room as close to exactly to setpoint without overheating or underheating

PID Controllers are used in commercial HVAC,  P (proportional only) , PI and PID

P (only) 

For example, to heat a classroom, using wall radiators installed under windows, P (only) proportional is used. Normally the thermostat is near the door entrance. This works well because, the the rise and fall in temperature (error from setpoint)  is very ,very slow (integral) using natural convection from the radiator. 
 
PI 

If the same classroom was using hot air for heating,  PI is used. The rise a fall in temperature (error from setpoint) can move faster, since you are forcing air around the room. An integral (or time based approach) help prevent rapid overheating / underheating from the setpoint. The mass majority of commercial thermostats use PI. 

PID 

Normally not used in a classroom, but rather in highly critical locations, like a lab, hospital or food processing use the (D) derivative part keep the room as close to exactly to setpoint without overheating or underheating
